## Cross Sell Opportunities

Enhance your ongoing technical operations with complementary AVENIQ services:

- **Cloud Deployment**: Upgrade your hosting environment to containerized Docker infrastructure with automated GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines.
- **Custom Software Development**: Build new enterprise software modules and workflow tools using your allocated maintenance development hours.
- **AI Automation**: Enhance your maintained software applications with automated n8n workflows and LLM data processing pipelines.
- **UI/UX Design**: Conduct periodic design audits to refresh interface visuals and optimize user conversion funnels.
